name: Whop
description: Whop lets agents read and change live data in the signed-in Whop account, such as products, memberships, and payments, and search the Whop developer documentation. Each user signs in to their own Whop account through the browser.

prompts.text: How many active memberships does each of my products have?
Summarize payments from the last 30 days by product.
How do I verify a Whop webhook in my app? Check the docs.

apps.name: Whop
apps.description: Live Whop data and documentation search, over Whop's MCP server with browser sign-in.
